subject: O Level Biology
title: Plant cell
question:
Fig. 1.1 shows a plant cell as seen under a light microscope.
(a) Identify the structures labelled A to E.
(b) State one function of structure C.
(c) Name the structure, labelled with a letter, that is partially permeable.

scene: First try: label E was placed inside the vacuole. In exams the labels sit outside the cell with a line pointing in.
Second try: the renderer now prefers to put labels outside the drawing.
svg: First try: label D was placed above the top edge of the image and got cut off.
Second try: made the image taller.

figure:
A plant cell as seen under a light microscope, a rounded rectangle taller than it is wide.
A cell wall on the outside and a cell membrane just inside it. Cytoplasm lightly shaded.
A large central vacuole. A nucleus with a nucleolus, pressed to one side near the top. About ten chloroplasts in the cytoplasm around the edges.
Use label lines with letters only, not names: A to the cell wall, B to the cell membrane, C to a chloroplast, D to the nucleus and E to the vacuole.
Caption: Fig. 1.1.
